as_told.title: Pasulka's Heaven Can Wait finds abduction-like accounts in Catholic sources

plain: While researching a book on Purgatory called Heaven Can Wait, which Michels dates to 2014, the religious studies professor Diana Pasulka of UNC Wilmington began to document dozens of historical cases of nuns, priests, brothers and saints who reported direct divine or angelic contact. Michels tells this himself, drawing on Pasulka's work. In another episode he gives no year, describes the accounts as more like abductions, and brings up Francis of Assisi, pointing to old church records that might hold encounters much like modern UFO experiences.
